question: In irritable bowel syndrome, it is true that:

options.opa: Routine laboratory studies (analysis) show specific abnormalities of this syndrome.
options.opb: Among the symptoms that make us think of an irritable bowel are: nighttime abdominal pain, progressive pain and weight loss.
options.opc: It courses with diarrhea or constipation; if both are manifested, this entity is ruled out.
options.opd: In patients with irritable bowel syndrome with predominance of diarrhea, the diagnostic study should include: stool culture, celiac disease screening, colonoscopy with biopsies.
